'''Jade''' was a kind of [[Color/Legends|green]] organic [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]].

==History==
Sometimes before [[3997 BBY]] the surface of the prized [[Tedryn Holocron]] was made from jade, possibly by [[Tedryn]].<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force real-life book">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>
